plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Business Honors (BBA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Refer to the specific major notes below for variations from the Business (lower level) requirements.
[grid1 fn2] MATH 148 , MATH 152 , MATH 168 and MATH 172 will be accepted in lieu of MATH 140 .
[grid1 fn3] For those students under ROTC contract, see Requirement 7 of the "Requirements for a Baccalaureate Degree."
[grid1 fn4] MATH 147 , MATH 151 and MATH 171 will be accepted in lieu of MATH 142 .
[grid1 fn5] STAT 211 will be accepted in lieu of BUSN 203 .
[grid2 fn1] Five of the nine Common Body of Knowledge classes listed must be taken as honors: ACCT 229 , ACCT 230 , FINC 341 , ISTM 210 , BUSN 203 , SCMT 364 , MGMT 311 , MGMT 363 , MKTG 321 .
[grid2 fn2] Refer to the major specific paragraph on the Lower-Level Business Program (BUAD). Select from approved creative arts elective courses.
[grid2 fn3] Six hours required. A complete list of approved courses is available in the Undergraduate Advising Office. In the BBA curricula, three hours of approved international elective coursework simultaneously fulfills the university's International and Cultural Diversity Graduation requirement.
[grid2 fn4] For those students under ROTC contract, see Requirement 7 of the 'Requirements for a Baccalaureate Degree.'
[grid2 fn5] Any 300- or 400-level business course (ACCT, FINC, IBUS, ISTM, MGMT, MKTG, SCMT) except FINC 341 , FINC 409 ; MGMT 309 , MGMT 363 , MGMT 466 ; MKTG 321 , MKTG 409 ; MGMT 311 , SCMT 309 , SCMT 364 . At least one course must be designated as writing designated (W) or oral communication (C). Select in consultation with an academic advisor.
[grid2 fn6] Select from ACCT 484 , BUSN 484 , FINC 484 , IBUS 484 , ISTM 484 , MGMT 484 , MKTG 484 , SCMT 484 .
[grid2 fn7] Elective courses are open to any course offered for university credit, except ACCT 209 , ACCT 210 , FINC 409 , IBUS 301 , ISTM 209 , MGMT 209 , MGMT 309 , MKTG 409 , SCMT 309 . Additional restrictions may apply; see academic advisor for information. May be taken on a satisfactory/unsatisfactory basis.
[grid2 fn8] Must be taken as honors.
